text: Rain on the wheelhouse roof and Gerrit tucked in his crate, so this one's a bit cheeky. Blind Melon, No Rain. [dryly] Somebody tell the sky.
Not a cloud over the lighthouse, and the deck's dry for once. Blind Melon, No Rain. Exactly as advertised.
It's coming down properly now, and the gutter on the wheelhouse can't keep up. The White Stripes, Three Hundred M.P.H. Torrential Outpour Blues. [mutters] Not three hundred. Feels like it.
Anchor chain groaning, Opa coughing, the whole boat leaning on her rope. MS MR, Hurricane. [quietly] Not quite one. Close enough for me.
The wind's up and the aerial's singing along. Noir Désir, Le Vent Nous Portera. The wind will carry us. [dryly] Let's hope the anchor disagrees.
The lighthouse is sweeping the water and I've got nowhere to be. Parov Stelar, All Night. That's the plan, anyway.
Broad Daylight, Gabriel Rios, and look at it out there: blue sky, the lighthouse white as a sheet. I can see the badger's path from here.
The tar on the deck's gone soft and Gerrit's panting with his beak open, which is not a good look. Noel Gallagher's High Flying Birds, In The Heat Of The Moment.
Spinvis, Ik Wil Alleen Maar Zwemmen. I want only to swim. On a day this warm, off the stern, with Gerrit keeping watch on my fish. Tempting.
Washing's pegged to the aerial wire and flapping like mad. Cold War Kids, Hang Me Up To Dry. Gerrit's furious; that's his perch.
Nothing's dried on this boat in a week. Cold War Kids, Hang Me Up To Dry. [sighs] Wishful thinking.
Cold enough out here that I've got the burner going just to hold my hands over it. Django Django, Firewater. I'll take the water. The fire's busy.
